title: Garden Shop
intro:
For Local gardeners, flower buyers, crafters, and gift shoppers in the East Bay.

Real goods from one Concord farm — plant starts, dried flowers, and handmade botanicals you can trace to a specific field and pick up in person.

title: Garden Fund
intro:
For Local donors, families connected to disability inclusion, and businesses ready to fund something real and verifiable.

Your money funds a named piece of infrastructure — a raised bed, a path segment, a loaner chair — and you see it get done.
